headline: Nine candidates shortlisted for position of Defender of the People
content: The special commission tasked with selecting the next Defender of the People reduced its candidate pool from twenty-eight down to nine. These include Samuel Abad, Guillermo Bettochi, Walter Guiterrez, Sergio Schiapachetti, Guido Lombardi, Eduardo Vega, Juan Domingo Cereros, Abelardo Ancco, and Gastón Sotto Vallenas. Further reductions were made until three remained for decision-making.  Calculations suggest there may soon be a new defender, reports Tiempo magazine.

headline: New poll shows Silva favored over Rousseff in Brazil’s presidential race
content: In first debates held in Brazil, environmental activist Marina Silva demanded explanations from President Rousseff regarding economic issues facing the country. According to polling agency MD&A, should it come to a second round, Silva would win against Rousseff with 43.7% compared to her 37.8%. In initial voting rounds, Rousseff holds support at 34.2%, while Silva leads with 28.2% among voters.

headline: Comienza fase de liquidación de Doe Run Peru

headline: Sobre la Ley Que Modifica el Sistema Privado de Pensiones (SPP)
content: Los congresistas que promovieron con mucho entusiasmo la modificación de la ley, perdieron totalmente de vista el objetivo principal del sistema privado de pensiones que es proveer una pensión a las personas, que en razón de la edad terminen su vida laboral productiva, es decir, que ya no puedan trabajar.  Estos congresistas han hecho casi imposible reducir las pensiones de los jubilados, que se pueden resumir en tres disposiciones legales:  1) Reducción por un periodo del aporte al fondo del 10% al 8%. Este movimiento causará que por este período los fondos y consecuentemente las pensiones sean menores en un 20%  2) Disminuciones, cuyo efecto será similar anterior en un 14%
